p282.original: Viscusi, Gregory, and Mark Deen. “Why France Has So Many 49-Employee Companies.” Business Week. Last modified May 3, 2012. http://www.businessweek.com/articles/2012-05-03/why-france-has-so-many-49-employee-companies.
p282.zh: 维斯库西,格雷戈里,和马克·迪恩.“为什么法国有这么多的49个雇员公司。”http://www.businessweek.com/articles/2012-05-03/why-france-has-so-many-49-employe-companises. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2012-09-02.

p283.original: Causes of Inflation in Various Countries and Regions
p283.zh: 各国和各区域的通货膨胀原因

p284.original: Policymakers of the high-income economies appear to have learned some lessons about fighting inflation. First, whatever happens with aggregate supply and aggregate demand in the short run, countries can use monetary policy to prevent inflation from becoming entrenched in the economy in the medium and long term. Second, there is no long-run gain to letting inflation become established. In fact, allowing inflation to become lasting and persistent poses undesirable risks and tradeoffs. When inflation is high, businesses and individuals need to spend time and effort worrying about protecting themselves against inflation, rather than seeking better ways to serve customers. In short, the high-income economies appear to have both a political consensus to hold inflation low and the economic tools to do so. Despite this, periods of growing inflation can stagnate economic growth and lead to significant political consequences for leaders. In 2022, the U.S. inflation rate reached 9.1%, an unexpected peak that the country hadn't seen since 1981. As is often the case, President Joe Biden was held politically responsible, and negotiated with Congress to pass a massive economic and climate bill titled the Inflation Reduction Act.
p284.zh: 高收入经济体的决策者似乎已经吸取了一些与通货膨胀作斗争的教训。 首先,无论短期内总供应和总需求如何,各国都可以利用货币政策防止通货膨胀在中长期内在经济中扎根。 第二,使通货膨胀得到确立不会有长期的好处。 事实上,让通货膨胀持久和持久,会带来不可取的风险和权衡。 当通货膨胀高的时候,企业和个人需要花时间和精力来担心保护自己不受通货膨胀的影响,而不是寻求更好的方式为客户服务.简言之,高收入经济体似乎既有保持低通货膨胀的政治共识,也有这样做的经济工具。 尽管如此,通货膨胀不断增长的时期可能会停滞经济增长,给领导人带来重大的政治后果.2022年,美国通货膨胀率达到9.1%,这是该国自1981年以来从未见过的意外高峰. 乔·拜登总统常常被追究政治责任,并与国会谈判,通过一项名为《减少通货膨胀法》的大规模经济和气候法案。

p285.original: In a number of middle- and low-income economies around the world, inflation is far from a solved problem. In the early 2000s, Turkey experienced inflation of more than 50% per year for several years and continues to experience high inflation today. Belarus had inflation of about 100% per year from 2000 to 2001. From 2008 to 2010, Venezuela and Myanmar had inflation rates of 20% to 30% per year. Indonesia, Iran, Nigeria, the Russian Federation, and Ukraine all had double-digit inflation for most of the years from 2000 to 2010. Zimbabwe had hyperinflation, with inflation rates that went from more than 100% per year in the mid-2000s to a rate of several million percent in 2008.
p285.zh: 在世界一些中等和低收入经济体中,通货膨胀远未解决。 在2000年代初,土耳其几年来每年的通货膨胀率超过50%,而且今天的通货膨胀率仍然很高。2000年至2001年,白俄罗斯的通货膨胀率约为每年100%。 从2008年到2010年,委内瑞拉和缅甸的通货膨胀率为每年20%至30%。 印度尼西亚、伊朗、尼日利亚、俄罗斯联邦和乌克兰在2000年至2010年的大部分时间里都出现了两位数的通货膨胀。津巴布韦出现恶性通货膨胀,通货膨胀率从2000年代中期的每年100%以上升至2008年的几百万。

p286.original: In these countries, the problem of very high inflation generally arises from huge budget deficits, which the government finances by printing its domestic currency. This is a case of “too much money chasing too few goods.” In the case of Venezuela, beginning in 2016 the government covered its widening deficits by printing ever higher currency notes, with inflation reaching 1,000,000% by 2018. The crisis continues today, with high rates of inflation and high unemployment (over 40%). There is some discussion of dollarization, or a conversion from Venezuelan bolivars to U.S. dollars as the main currency, as a solution to the hyperinflation. Even in 2019, over 50% of transactions in Venezuela were reportedly using U.S. dollars, and banks issued debit cards denominated in U.S. dollars in 2021.
p286.zh: 在这些国家,通货膨胀非常高的问题一般来自巨大的预算赤字,政府通过印制本国货币来资助这些赤字.委内瑞拉的情况是,政府从2016年开始通过印制比以往更高的纸币来弥补其日益扩大的赤字,到2018年通胀率达到1,000,000 % 。危机今天仍在继续,通货膨胀率高,失业率高(超过40%)。也有人讨论美元化, 或从委内瑞拉的bolivars转换成美元作为主要货币,即使在2019年,据报道委内瑞拉50%以上的交易使用美元,银行在2021年发行了以美元计价的借记卡.

p287.original: A number of countries have managed to sustain solid levels of economic growth for sustained periods of time with inflation levels that would sound high by recent U.S. standards, like 10% to 30% per year. In such economies, the governments index most contracts, wage levels, and interest rates to inflation. Indexing wage contracts and interest rates means that they will increase when inflation increases to retain purchasing power. When wages do not rise as price levels rise, this leads to a decline in the real wage rate and a decrease in the standard of living. Likewise, interest rates that are not indexed mean that money lenders will receive payment in devalued currency and will also lose purchasing power on monies that they lent. It is clearly possible—and perhaps sometimes necessary—for a converging economy (the economy of a country that demonstrates the ability to catch up to the technology leaders) to live with a degree of uncertainty over inflation that would be politically unacceptable in the high-income economies.
p287.zh: 一些国家成功地维持了持续一段时间的稳固经济增长水平,通货膨胀率达到美国最近标准,每年达到10%至30%。 在这些经济体中,政府将大多数合同、工资水平和利率与通货膨胀挂钩。将工资合同和利率指数化意味着,当通货膨胀上升以保持购买力时,这些合同和利率将会增加。 当工资没有随着物价水平的上涨而上升时,这会导致实际工资率的下降和生活水平的下降. 同样,没有指数化的利率意味着放款人将获得贬值货币的付款,并失去对借出资金的购买力。 显然,对于一个趋同的经济(一个能够向技术领袖示好的国家的经济)来说,有可能而且有时也是必要的,因为通货膨胀的不确定性在高收入经济体在政治上是无法接受的。

p289.original: Most high-income economies have learned that their central banks can control inflation in the medium and the long term. In addition, they have learned that inflation has no long-term benefits but potentially substantial long-term costs if it distracts businesses from focusing on real productivity gains. However, smaller economies around the world may face more volatile inflation because their smaller economies can be unsettled by international movements of capital and goods.
p289.zh: 大多数高收入经济体都了解到,其中央银行能够控制中长期通货膨胀。 此外,他们了解到,如果通货膨胀分散企业对实际生产力收益的注意力,那么通货膨胀不会带来长期利益,而是可能产生巨大的长期成本。 然而,世界各地的较小经济体可能面临更不稳定的通货膨胀,因为它们的较小经济体可能因资本和货物的国际流动而不安。

p291.original: How does indexing wage contracts to inflation help workers?
p291.zh: 将工资合同与通货膨胀挂钩对工人有何帮助?

p292.original: Indexing wage contracts means wages rise when prices rise. This means what you can buy with your wages, your standard of living, remains the same. When wages are not indexed, or rise with inflation, your standard of living falls.
p292.zh: 将工资合同指数化是指物价上涨时工资上涨.也就是说,用你的工资,生活标准可以买到的东西保持不变. 当工资没有指数化,或者随着通货膨胀而上升时,你的生活水平就会下降.

p293.original: Use the AD/AS model to show how increases in government spending can lead to more inflation.
p293.zh: 使用AD/AS模式来显示政府支出的增加如何会导致更多的通货膨胀.

p294.original: An increase in government spending shifts the AD curve to the right, raising both income and price levels.
p294.zh: 政府支出的增加使反倾销曲线向右转移,提高了收入和价格水平。

p295.original: Show, using the AD/AS model, how governments can use monetary policy to decrease the price level.
p295.zh: 运用AD/AS模式显示政府如何利用货币政策降低价格水平.

p296.original: A decrease in the money supply will shift the AD curve leftward and reduce income and price levels. Banks will have less money to lend. Interest rates will increase, affecting consumption and investment, which are both key determinants of aggregate demand.
p296.zh: 货币供应的减少将改变反倾销曲线,降低收入和价格水平。银行的贷款会减少。利率将上升,影响消费和投资,而消费和投资既是总需求的关键决定因素。

p298.original: Is inflation likely to be a severe problem for at least some high-income economies in the near future?
p298.zh: 在最近的将来,通货膨胀可能至少对一些高收入经济体是一个严重的问题吗?

p299.original: Is inflation likely to be a problem for at least some low- and middle-income economies in the near future?
p299.zh: 在最近的将来,通货膨胀至少对一些低收入和中等收入经济体来说是否是一个问题?

p301.original: Why are inflationary dangers lower in the high-income economies than in low-income and middle-income economies?
p301.zh: 高收入经济体的通货膨胀危险为何低于低收入和中等收入经济体?

p303.original: Retrieve inflation data from The World Bank data base (http://databank.worldbank.org/data/home.aspx) for India, Spain, and South Africa for 2011–2015. Prepare a chart that compares India, Spain, and South Africa based on the data. Describe the key differences between the countries. Rank these countries as high-, medium-, and low-income. Explain what is surprising or expected about the data.
p303.zh: 从世界银行数据库(http://databank.worldbank.org/data/home.aspx)获取2011-2015年印度、西班牙和南非的通货膨胀数据。 根据数据编制一份比较印度、西班牙和南非的图表。说明各国之间的主要差异。这些国家被评为高、中、低收入国家。解释数据令人惊讶或预期会是什么。

p305.original: In the 1950s and 1960s, and even into the 1970s, low- and middle-income countries often viewed openness to global flows of goods, services, and financial capital in a negative light. These countries feared that foreign trade would mean both economic losses as high-income trading partners "exploited" their economy and they lost domestic political control to powerful business interests and multinational corporations.
p305.zh: 在1950年代和1960年代,甚至到1970年代,中低收入国家往往从负面角度看待对商品、服务和金融资本全球流动的开放。这些国家担心外贸既意味着作为高收入贸易伙伴的经济损失,也意味着它们的经济"被开发",它们也失去了国内对强大的商业利益集团和跨国公司的政治控制.

p306.original:
These negative feelings about international trade have evolved. After all, the great economic success stories of recent years like Japan, the East Asian Tiger economies, China, and India, all took advantage of opportunities to sell in global markets. European economies thrive with high levels of trade. In the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA),
  As of July 1, 2020, NAFTA was officially replaced with the United States-Mexico-Canada (USMCA) free trade agreement. It is broadly similar to the original NAFTA. 
  the United States, Canada, and Mexico pledged themselves to reduce trade barriers. Many countries have clearly learned that reducing barriers to trade is at least potentially beneficial to the economy. Many smaller world economies have learned an even tougher lesson: if they do not participate actively in world trade, they are unlikely to join the success stories among the converging economies. There are no examples in world history of small economies that remained apart from the global economy but still attained a high standard of living.
p306.zh: 这些对国际贸易的负面感情已经演变。毕竟,近年来日本,东亚虎经济,中国,印度等经济大获成功的故事,都借机在全球市场上销售. 欧洲经济在高水平的贸易中蓬勃发展。 在北美自由贸易协定(NAFTA)中,截至2020年7月1日,北美自由贸易协定正式被美国-墨西哥-加拿大(USMCA)自由贸易协定取代. 它与最初的《北美自由贸易协定》大致相似,美国、加拿大和墨西哥承诺减少贸易壁垒。 许多国家清楚地认识到,减少贸易壁垒至少对经济有潜在好处。 许多较小的世界经济已经吸取了更严峻的教训:如果不积极参与世界贸易,它们就不太可能加入到趋同的经济体中的成功事例中。 世界历史上没有小经济体与全球经济保持隔阂、但仍能达到高生活水平的例子。

p307.original: Although almost every country now claims that its goal is to participate in global trade, the possible negative consequences have remained highly controversial. It is useful to divide these possible negative consequences into issues involving trade of goods and services and issues involving international capital flows. These issues are related, but not the same. An economy may have a high level of trade in goods and services relative to GDP, but if exports and imports are balanced, the net flow of foreign investment in and out of the economy will be zero. Conversely, an economy may have only a moderate level of trade relative to GDP, but find that it has a substantial current account trade imbalance. Thus, it is useful to consider the concerns over international trade of goods and services and international flows of financial capital separately.
p307.zh: 虽然现在几乎所有国家都声称其目标是参与全球贸易,但可能产生的消极后果仍然引起很大争议。将这些可能的负面影响分为涉及货物和服务贸易的问题和涉及国际资本流动的问题是有益的。这些问题相互关联,但并不相同。 一个经济体的货物和服务贸易额可能与国内生产总值相比较高,但如果进出口平衡,外国投资进出经济的净流量将是零。 相反,一个经济体相对于国内生产总值可能只有中等水平的贸易,但发现它经常账户贸易不平衡。 因此,有必要分别审议对国际货物和服务贸易以及国际金融资本流动的关切。

p308.original: Concerns over International Trade in Goods and Services
p308.zh: 对货物和服务国际贸易的关切

p309.original: There is a long list of worries about foreign trade in goods and services: fear of job loss, environmental dangers, unfair labor practices, and many other concerns. We discuss these arguments at some length in the chapter on The International Trade and Capital Flows.
p309.zh: 关于货物和服务的对外贸易,人们有一大堆担忧:害怕失业、环境危险、不公平的劳工做法和许多其他关切。 我们在关于国际贸易和资本流动的一章中较详细地讨论了这些论点。

p310.original: Of all of the arguments for limitations on trade, perhaps the most controversial one among economists is the infant industry argument; that is, subsidizing or protecting new industries for a time until they become established. (Globalization and Protectionism explains this concept in more detail.) Countries have used such policies with some success at certain points in time, but in the world as a whole, support for key industries is far more often directed at long-established industries with substantial political power that are suffering losses and laying off workers, rather than potentially vibrant new industries that are not yet established. If government intends to favor certain industries, it needs to do so in a way that is temporary and that orients them toward a future of market competition, rather than a future of unending government subsidies and trade protection.
p310.zh: 在所有关于贸易限制的论点中,经济学家中最有争议的或许是新兴产业的论点,即补贴或保护新产业一段时间直至它们建立起来。(全球化和保护主义更详细地解释了这一概念. )各国在某些时间点上运用了这种政策,取得了一定的成功,但是在整个世界,对关键产业的支持更倾向于长期存在的、拥有巨大政治力量的产业,这些产业正在遭受损失和解雇工人,而不是尚未建立起来的具有潜在活力的新产业。 如果政府打算对某些产业倾斜,它就需要以一种临时性的方式这样做,并引导它们走向市场竞争的未来,而不是政府补贴和贸易保护的无休止的未来。

p311.original: Concerns over International Flows of Capital
p311.zh: 对国际资本流动的关切

p312.original: Recall from The Macroeconomic Perspective that a trade deficit exists when a nation’s imports exceed its exports. In order for a trade deficit to take place, foreign countries must provide loans or investments, which they are willing to do because they expect eventual repayment (that the deficit will become a surplus). A trade surplus, you may remember, exists when a nation’s exports exceed its imports. Thus, in order for a trade deficit to switch to a trade surplus, a nation’s exports must rise and its imports must fall. Sometimes this happens when the currency decreases in value. For example, if the U.S. had a trade deficit and the dollar depreciated, imports would become more expensive. This would, in turn, benefit the foreign countries that provided the loans or investments.
p312.zh: 从宏观经济角度回顾,当一个国家的进口超过其出口时,就存在贸易赤字。 为了实现贸易逆差,外国必须提供贷款或投资,它们愿意这样做,因为它们期望最终还款(赤字将成为盈余)。 当一个国家的出口超过其进口时,贸易顺差就会存在,你可能记得。 因此,为了使贸易逆差转变为贸易顺差,一个国家的出口必须增加,进口必须减少。 有时,当货币贬值时,就会发生这种情况。 例如,如果美国出现贸易逆差,美元贬值,进口就会更加昂贵.反过来,这将有利于提供贷款或投资的外国。

p313.original: The expected pattern of trade imbalances in the world economy has been that high-income economies will run trade surpluses, which means they will experience a net outflow of capital to foreign destinations or export more than they import, while low- and middle-income economies will run trade deficits, which means that they will experience a net inflow of foreign capital.
p313.zh: 世界经济中贸易失衡的预期模式是,高收入经济体将出现贸易盈余,这意味着它们将经历资本净外流到外国目的地或出口超过进口,而低收入和中等收入经济体将出现贸易赤字,这意味着它们将经历外国资本净流入。

p314.original: This international investing pattern can benefit all sides. Investors in the high-income countries benefit because they can receive high returns on their investments, and also because they can diversify their investments so that they are at less risk of a downturn in their own domestic economy. The low-income economies that receive an inflow of capital presumably have potential for rapid catch-up economic growth, and they can use the international financial capital inflow to help spur their physical capital investment. In addition, financial capital inflows often come with management abilities, technological expertise, and training.
p314.zh: 这种国际投资模式可以使各方受益。高收入国家的投资者从中受益,因为他们的投资收益很高,而且他们的投资可以多样化,从而减少本国经济下滑的风险。接受资本流入的低收入经济体可能具有迅速赶超经济增长的潜力,它们可以利用国际金融资本流入来帮助刺激其有形资本投资。 此外,资金流入往往伴随着管理能力、技术专长和培训。

p315.original: However, for the last couple of decades, this cheerful scenario has faced two “dark clouds.” The first cloud is the very large trade or current account deficits in the U.S. economy. (See The International Trade and Capital Flows.) Instead of offering net financial investment abroad, the U.S. economy is soaking up savings from all over the world. These substantial U.S. trade deficits may not be sustainable according to Sebastian Edwards writing for the National Bureau of Economic Research. While trade deficits on their own are not bad, the question is whether governments will reduce them gradually or hastily. In the gradual scenario, U.S. exports could grow more rapidly than imports over a period of years, aided by U.S. dollar depreciation. An unintended consequence of the slow growth since the Great Recession has been a decline in the U.S. current account deficit's from 6% pre-recession to 3% most recently.
p315.zh: 然而,在过去几十年中,这种令人高兴的情景面临着两个“暗云 ” 。 第一道云是美国经济中巨大的贸易赤字或经常账户赤字。(见"国际贸易与资本流动". )美国经济没有提供国外的净金融投资,反而挤压着世界各地储蓄. 根据Sebastian Edwards为国家经济研究局撰写的文章,这些巨大的美国贸易赤字可能无法持续. 虽然贸易赤字本身并不坏,但问题是政府是逐步还是仓促减少。 在逐步的假设中,美国出口的增长可能比进口在几年内更快,而美国美元贬值则起到了辅助作用。 大衰退以来增长缓慢的一个意外后果是美国经常账户赤字从6%的前衰退下降到最近3%。

p316.original: The other option is that the government could reduce the U.S. trade deficit in a rush. Here is one scenario: if foreign investors became less willing to hold U.S. dollar assets, the dollar exchange rate could weaken. As speculators see this process happening, they might rush to unload their dollar assets, which would drive the dollar down still further.
p316.zh: 另一种选择是政府可以急速减少美国的贸易赤字.一种情况是:如果外国投资者不太愿意持有美元资产,美元汇率可能会减弱。 正如投机者所见,他们可能急于卸下他们的美元资产,这将进一步推低美元。

p317.original: A lower U.S. dollar would stimulate aggregate demand by making exports cheaper and imports more expensive. It would mean higher prices for imported inputs throughout the economy, shifting the short-term aggregate supply curve to the left. The result could be a burst of inflation and, if the Federal Reserve were to run a tight monetary policy to reduce the inflation, it could also lead to recession. People sometimes talk as if the U.S. economy, with its great size, is invulnerable to this sort of pressure from international markets. While it is difficult to rock, it is not impossible for the $17 trillion U.S. economy to face these international pressures.
p317.zh: 降低美元将刺激总需求,使出口更便宜,进口更昂贵。 这意味着整个经济的进口投入价格较高,短期总供应曲线向左转移。其结果可能是通货膨胀的爆发,如果美联储要实行紧缩的货币政策以减少通货膨胀,它也可能导致衰退. 人们有时会说话,好像拥有巨大规模的美国经济对国际市场的这种压力是无情的。 虽然难以摇摆,但美国17万亿美元经济却并非不可能面对这些国际压力.

p318.original: The second “dark cloud” is how the smaller world economies should deal with the possibility of sudden foreign financial capital inflows and outflows. Perhaps the most vivid recent example of the potentially destructive forces of international capital movements occurred in the East Asian Tiger economies in 1997–1998. Thanks to their excellent growth performance over the previous few decades, these economies had attracted considerable interest from foreign investors. In the mid-1990s, however, foreign investment into these countries surged even further. Much of this money funneled through banks that borrowed in U.S. dollars and loaned in their national currencies. Bank lending surged at rates of 20% per year or more. This inflow of foreign capital meant that investment in these economies exceeded the level of domestic savings, so that current account deficits in these countries jumped into the 5–10% GDP range.
p318.zh: 第二个“暗云”是较小的世界经济应如何处理外国金融资本突然流入和流出的可能性。 也许,在1997-1998年期间,东亚的虎式经济中出现了国际资本流动潜在破坏性力量的最近最生动的例子。 由于这些经济体在过去几十年中出色的增长表现,吸引了外国投资者的极大兴趣。 然而,在1990年代中期,对这些国家的外国投资进一步激增。这笔钱大部分通过以美元借款并以本国货币贷款的银行流出。银行贷款以每年20%或20%以上的速度激增。外国资本的流入意味着对这些国家的投资超过国内储蓄水平,因此这些国家的经常账户赤字跃升到国内生产总值的5-10%。

p319.original: The surge in bank lending meant that many banks in these East Asian countries did not do an especially good job of screening out safe and unsafe borrowers. Many of the loans—as high as 10% to 15% of all loans in some of these countries—started to turn bad. Fearing losses, foreign investors started pulling out their money. As the foreign money left, the exchange rates of these countries crashed, often falling by 50% or more in a few months. The banks were stuck with a mismatch: even if the rest of their domestic loans were repaid, they could never pay back the U.S. dollars that they owed. The banking sector as a whole went bankrupt. The lack of credit and lending in the economy collapsed aggregate demand, bringing on a deep recession.
p319.zh: 银行贷款的激增意味着,这些东亚国家的许多银行在排除安全和不安全的借款人方面做得特别好。 许多贷款——在其中一些国家高达全部贷款的10%至15%——开始变得糟糕。 由于担心损失,外国投资者开始抽出资金。 随着外国货币的离去,这些国家的汇率崩溃,在几个月内经常下降50%或更多.银行陷入了不匹配状态:即使国内贷款的其余部分得到偿还,它们也永远无法还清所欠的美国美元.整个银行部门破产。经济中缺乏信贷和贷款使总需求崩溃,导致深度衰退。

p320.original: If the flow and ebb of international capital markets can flip even the economies of the East Asian Tigers, with their stellar growth records, into a recession, then it is no wonder that other middle- and low-income countries around the world are concerned. Moreover, similar episodes of an inflow and then an outflow of foreign financial capital have rocked a number of economies around the world: for example, in the last few years, economies like Ireland, Iceland, and Greece have all experienced severe shocks when foreign lenders decided to stop extending funds. Especially in Greece, this caused the government to enact austerity measures which led to protests throughout the country ().
p320.zh: 如果国际资本市场的流通和疲软,甚至东亚虎的经济体,以其惊人的增长记录,都能够陷入衰退,那么全世界其他中低收入国家对此毫不奇怪。 此外,类似的外国金融资本流入和流出事件也震撼了世界各地的一些经济体:例如,在过去几年中,爱尔兰、冰岛和希腊等经济体在外国放款人决定停止扩大资金时都经历了严重的冲击。特别是在希腊,这导致政府采取紧缩措施,导致全国各地的抗议活动(.

p322.original: Many nations are taking steps to reduce the risk that their economy will be injured if foreign financial capital takes flight, including having their central banks hold large reserves of foreign exchange and stepping up their regulation of domestic banks to avoid a wave of imprudent lending. The most controversial steps in this area involve whether countries should try to take steps to control or reduce the flows of foreign capital. If a country could discourage some speculative short-term capital inflow, and instead only encourage investment capital that it committed for the medium and the long term, then it could be at least somewhat less susceptible to swings in the sentiments of global investors.
p322.zh: 许多国家正在采取步骤,减少如果外国金融资本外逃,其经济将受到损害的风险,包括让其中央银行持有大量外汇储备,并加紧对国内银行的监管,以避免一波不审慎的贷款浪潮。 这方面最有争议的步骤是,各国是否应该设法采取步骤控制或减少外国资本的流动。 如果一个国家能够阻止一些投机性的短期资本流入,而只是鼓励它承诺的中长期投资资本,那么它至少就不那么容易受到全球投资者情绪波动的影响。

p323.original: If economies participate in the global trade of goods and services, they will also need to participate in international flows of financial payments and investments. These linkages can offer great benefits to an economy. However, any nation that is experiencing a substantial and sustained pattern of trade deficits, along with the corresponding net inflow of international financial capital, has some reason for concern. During the Asian Financial Crisis in the late 1990s, countries that grew dramatically in the years leading up to the crisis as international capital flowed in, saw their economies collapse when the capital very quickly flowed out.
p323.zh: 如果各经济体参与全球货物和服务贸易,它们也需要参与国际金融支付和投资流动。 这些联系可为经济带来巨大好处。 然而,任何贸易赤字持续严重的国家,以及相应的国际金融资本净流入,都值得关注。1990年代后期亚洲金融危机期间,随着国际资本流入,危机发生前的几年里急剧增长的国家,在资本迅速流入时,经济崩溃。

p325.original: The standard of living has increased dramatically for billions of people around the world in the last half century. Such increases have occurred not only in the technological leaders like the United States, Canada, the nations of Europe, and Japan, but also in the East Asian Tigers and in many nations of Latin America and Eastern Europe. The challenge for most of these countries is to maintain these growth rates. The economically-challenged regions of the world have stagnated and become stuck in poverty traps. These countries need to focus on the basics: health and education, or human capital development. As  illustrates, modern technology allows for the investment in education and human capital development in ways that would have not been possible just a few short years ago.
p325.zh: 在过去半个世纪里,全世界数十亿人的生活水平急剧提高。 这种增长不仅发生在美国,加拿大,欧洲国家,日本等技术领先国家,也发生在东亚虎以及拉丁美洲和东欧的许多国家. 对大多数这些国家来说,挑战是如何维持这些增长率。 世界经济困难地区停滞不前,陷入贫困陷阱。这些国家需要把重点放在基本方面:保健和教育,或人力资本发展。 如前所述,现代技术允许以几年前不可能的方式对教育和人力资本发展进行投资。

p327.original: Other than the issue of economic growth, the other three main goals of macroeconomic policy—that is, low unemployment, low inflation, and a sustainable balance of trade—all involve situations in which, for some reason, the economy fails to coordinate the forces of supply and demand. In the case of cyclical unemployment, for example, the intersection of aggregate supply and aggregate demand occurs at a level of output below potential GDP. In the case of the natural rate of unemployment, government regulations create a situation where otherwise-willing employers become unwilling to hire otherwise-willing workers. Inflation is a situation in which aggregate demand outstrips aggregate supply, at least for a time, so that too much buying power is chasing too few goods. A trade imbalance is a situation where, because of a net inflow or outflow of foreign capital, domestic savings are not aligned with domestic investment. Each of these situations can create a range of easier or harder policy choices.
p327.zh: 除经济增长问题外,宏观经济政策的其他三个主要目标——即低失业率、低通货膨胀和贸易可持续平衡——都涉及经济由于某种原因未能协调供求力量的情况。 例如,就周期性失业而言,总供应和总需求之间的交汇点在产出水平上低于潜在的国内生产总值。 就自然失业率而言,政府条例造成了一种情况,即否则的雇主不愿意雇用自愿的工人。通货膨胀是总需求超过总供应的情况,至少是一段时间,因此太多的购买力正在追逐太少的货物。贸易不平衡是指由于外国资本净流入或流出,国内储蓄与国内投资不相适应的情况。每一种情况都可能产生一系列较容易或较难的政策选择。

p329.original: Spain and South Africa had the same high youth unemployment in 2020, but the reasons for this unemployment are different. Spain’s current account balance is negative, which means it is borrowing heavily. To cure cyclical unemployment during a recession, the Keynesian model suggests increases in government spending—fiscal expansion or monetary expansion. Neither option is open to Spain. It currently can borrow at only high interest rates, which will be a real problem in terms of debt service. In addition, the rest of the European Union (EU) has dragged its feet when it comes to debt forgiveness. Monetary expansion is not possible because Spain uses the euro and cannot devalue its currency unless it convinces all of the EU to do so. What can be done? The Economist, summarizing some ideas of economists and policymakers, suggests that Spain’s only realistic (although painful) option is to reduce government-mandated wages, which would allow it to reduce government spending. As a result, the government would be able to lower tax rates on the working population. With a lower wage or lower tax environment, firms will hire more workers. This will lower unemployment and stimulate the economy. Spain can also encourage greater foreign investment and try to promote policies that encourage domestic savings.
p329.zh: 西班牙和南非在2020年青年失业率同样高,但失业原因不同. 西班牙的经常账户余额为负数,这意味着它正在大量借款。 为了治疗衰退期间的周期性失业,凯恩斯主义模式建议增加政府开支——财政扩张或货币扩张.这两种选择都不向西班牙开放。 它目前只能以高利率借贷,这在偿债方面将是一个真正的问题。 此外,欧洲联盟(欧盟)其他国家在免除债务方面拖了拖拉拉。货币扩张是不可能的,因为西班牙使用欧元,除非说服欧盟所有国家,否则不能贬值货币.还能做些什么呢? 《经济学家》总结了经济学家和决策者的一些想法,认为西班牙唯一现实(尽管痛苦)的选择是降低政府授权的工资,这样可以减少政府开支。 因此,政府将能够降低劳动人口的税率。 在工资较低或税收较低的情况下,公司将雇用更多的工人。 这将降低失业率,刺激经济。 西班牙还可以鼓励更多的外国投资,并努力推行鼓励国内储蓄的政策。

p330.original: South Africa has more of a natural rate of unemployment problem. It is an interesting case because its youth unemployment is mostly because its young are not ready to work. Economists commonly refer to this as an employability problem. According to interviews of South African firms as reported in the Economist, the young are academically smart but lack practical skills for the workplace. Despite a big push to increase investment in human capital, the results have not yet borne fruit. Recently the government unveiled a plan to pay unemployed youth while they were “trained-up” or apprenticed in South African firms. The government has room to increase fiscal expenditure, encourage domestic savings, and continue to fund investment in education, vocational training, and apprentice programs. South Africa can also improve the climate for foreign investment from technology leaders, which would encourage economic growth.
p330.zh: 南非的自然失业率问题较多。 这是一个有趣的案例,因为它的青年失业主要是因为它的青年还没有准备好工作。经济学家通常将此称为可就业性问题。 根据《经济学家》中报告的对南非公司的访谈,年轻人在学术上很聪明,但缺乏工作场所的实际技能。 尽管大力推动增加人力资本投资,但结果尚未见成效。 最近,政府公布了一个向失业青年支付报酬的计划,他们在南非公司接受“培训”或学徒。 政府有余地增加财政支出,鼓励国内储蓄,并继续资助教育、职业培训和学徒方案的投资。 南非还可以改善技术领袖的外国投资环境,这将鼓励经济增长。

p331.original: India has a smaller youth employment problem in terms of percentages. However, bear in mind that since this is a populous country, it turns out to be a significant problem in raw numbers. According to Kaushik Basu, writing for the BBC, “there are 45 national laws governing the hiring and firing decisions of firms and close to four times that amount at the state level”. These laws make it difficult for companies to fire workers. To stay nimble and responsive to markets, Indian companies respond to these laws by hiring fewer workers. The Indian government can do much to solve this problem by adjusting its labor laws. Essentially, the government has to remove itself from firms’ hiring and firing decisions, so that growing Indian firms can freely employ more workers. Indian workers, like those in South Africa, do not have workforce skills. Again, the government can increase its spending on education, vocational training, and workforce readiness programs.
p331.zh: 印度的青年就业问题在百分比方面较小。 然而,铭记着由于这是一个人口众多的国家,它实际上在原始数字上是一个重大问题。 根据为英国广播公司撰写的Kaushik Basu的文章,“有45项国家法律管辖公司的雇用和解雇决定,在州一级将近4倍。”这些法律使得公司很难解雇工人. 为了保持灵活和对市场的反应,印度公司通过雇用较少的工人来响应这些法律。印度政府可以通过调整其劳动法来做很多工作来解决这个问题.基本上,政府必须让自己从公司的雇用和解雇决定中解脱出来,这样,不断增长的印度公司就可以自由地雇用更多的工人。 印度工人与南非工人一样,没有劳动力技能。 政府还可以增加教育、职业培训和劳动力准备方案方面的开支。

p332.original: Finally, India has a significant current account deficit. This deficit is mainly a result of short- and long-term capital flows. To solve this deficit, India has experimented by lifting the limitation on domestic savers from investing abroad. This is a step in the right direction that may dampen the growth in the current account deficit. A final policy possibility is to improve domestic capital markets so many self-employed Indians can obtain access to capital to realize their business ideas. If more Indians can obtain access to capital to start businesses, employment might increase.
p332.zh: 最后,印度经常账户出现严重赤字。 这种赤字主要是短期和长期资本流动的结果。 为了解决这一赤字,印度尝试取消对国内储蓄者在国外投资的限制。 这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步,可能会抑制经常账户赤字的增长。 最后的政策可能性是改善国内资本市场,使许多自营职业的印度人能够获得实现商业思想的资本。 如果有更多的印度人能够获得创办企业的资本,就业可能会增加。

p334.original: There are many legitimate concerns over possible negative consequences of free trade. Perhaps the single strongest response to these concerns is that there are good ways to address them without restricting trade and thus losing its benefits. There are two major issues involving trade imbalances. One is what will happen with the large U.S. trade deficits, and whether they will come down gradually or with a rush. The other is whether smaller countries around the world should take some steps to limit flows of international capital, in the hope that they will not be quite so susceptible to economic whiplash from international financial capital flowing in and out of their economies.
p334.zh: 对自由贸易可能产生的消极后果,人们有多种合理的关切。 也许对这些关切最有力的反应是,有良好的办法解决这些关切,同时又不限制贸易,从而失去贸易的好处。有两个主要问题涉及贸易不平衡。 一是美国巨额贸易赤字将发生什么,是逐渐下台还是急速下台. 另一个问题是,世界各地的小国是否应该采取一些步骤限制国际资本的流动,希望它们不会非常容易受到国际资本流入和流出其经济的经济鞭策。

p336.original: What do international flows of capital have to do with trade imbalances?
p336.zh: 国际资本流动与贸易不平衡有什么关系?

p337.original: Given the high level of activity in international financial markets, it is typically believed that financial flows across borders are the real reason for trade imbalances. For example, the United States had an enormous trade deficit in the late 1990s and early 2000s because it was attracting vast inflows of foreign capital. Smaller countries that have attracted such inflows of international capital worry that if the inflows suddenly turn to outflows, the resulting decline in their currency could collapse their banking system and bring on a deep recession.
p337.zh: 鉴于国际金融市场活动频繁,人们通常认为,跨界资金流动是贸易不平衡的真正原因。 例如,美国在1990年代末和2000年代初出现了巨大的贸易逆差,因为它吸引了大量的外国资本流入。吸引这种国际资本流入的小国担心,如果流入突然转向流出,其货币的下跌可能使其银行系统崩溃,并造成深度衰退。
